rationale: The fixed 39k/10k VREF divider and 0.24-ohm regulation resistors set 0.351 A nominal and <=0.379 A at +5% supply / 1% resistor extremes. Phase transitions are bounded to 20 mm per net, with >=0.30 mm main paths and independent Kelvin pickup checks. Ground-reference area, USB return continuity and measured thermal performance remain separate electrical-release checks.
USB_construction_reference_rationale: Pair outer edge is 0.330 mm from the centreline. A 0.400 mm construction buffer plus the existing 0.15 mm copper clearance and 0.02 mm grid margin leaves 0.04 mm beyond the 0.20 mm ground-fill setback. Final exact full-track ground-reference geometry remains mandatory.
analog_inner1_rationale: Permit a short filtered ADC branch on the fourth available copper layer to escape the fixed SOIC/QFN fanout field. The 0.16 mm width, 0.15 mm foreign clearance, 30 mm maximum section length and independent return-path qualification remain in force.
